title: claude-kit project configuration
description: Every project-specific value the kit's rules, hooks, agents and skills read. Lives at <project>/.claude/kit.config.json. Hooks read it through core/hooks/lib/config.js; defaults below apply when a key is absent.

kitVersion.description: Version of the kit this config was generated for; install.js --update compares it.

name.description: Short project name used in generated headings.

description.description: One line: what the project is.

root.description: Project root. Keep the default so hooks resolve it from the environment; never hard-code a machine path.

leadTitle.description: How the human is addressed in task files, plans and replies.

replyLanguage.description: Language of conversation with the human (BCP 47 tag).

artifactLanguage.description: Language of code, comments, commits and repository docs.

worker.description: Model for implementer, tester, build-resolver, explorer, Explore, Plan, general-purpose.

reviewer.description: Model for the reviewer agent and any ad-hoc review.

forceAll.description: When true every sub agent, reviewer included, must use models.worker (the subagent-model-guard hook enforces it).

allowFork.description: Allow subagent_type fork. Off by default: a fork carries the leader's context and model.

gates.description: Who approves each gate by default. 'human' is the core default; 'leader' records a standing delegation that project/rules.md must explain and scope.

name.description: Exact user.name the repo-local config must hold.

email.description: Exact user.email the repo-local config must hold.

deniedEmails.description: Addresses that must never appear as author or committer (for example a personal account).

aiAttribution.description: Only 'deny' exists: no Co-Authored-By, no 'Generated with', no tool or model name in commits, tags, merges or PR bodies.

forbiddenPhrases.description: Case-insensitive substrings denied in commit messages and PR bodies, in addition to the built-in attribution patterns.

commitCadence.description: task: one commit per closed task (core default). phase: the leader batches several tasks. wp: work-package pack, implementer commits on its own branch.

push.description: ask: every push asks the human. deny: local-only repository, push and remote changes are blocked.

forcePush.description: ask-with-lease: --force-with-lease asks, plain --force and +refspec are denied. deny: all force pushes denied.

branchPattern.description: Branch name pattern when whoCommits is implementer-branch, with {id} and {slug} placeholders.

gitExe.description: Full path to git when it is not on PATH (portable git). Empty means 'git'.

paths.description: All paths are relative to project.root unless absolute. Pattern forms: "dir/" = the directory and everything below; "a/b.txt" = exactly that path (a directory named this way is protected itself, not its children); "*.ts" = glob on the basename or the first path segment; "docs/*.md" = glob on the whole relative path.

readOnly.description: Never edited, deleted, moved into or written over by any mechanism (reference extracts, vendored drops).

askBeforeEdit.description: Edits ask the human first (third-party trees).

localOnly.description: Untracked data git cannot restore; deletes ask first.

protectedDelete.description: Never deleted, not even by the task: .git/, the .claude folder itself (its docs, tasks and scratch may be cleaned), the kit files and the memory mirror. Hook files and settings are protected from shell writes as well.

forbiddenTreeFiles.description: File names that must not exist in the repo tree outside .claude/.

scratch.description: Project-local scratch folder agents may use and clean freely (in addition to the session scratchpad).

tempRoots.description: Extra directories outside the project where Claude's own temp files may be deleted without asking. The session scratchpad and the Claude temp folder are always allowed.

docsGateRoots.description: Tracked documentation roots checked for forbidden vocabulary (.claude, agent, AI, plan, phase, owner, absolute paths).

neverKill.description: Process names (without .exe) that are never killed, by name or by PID.

neverLaunch.description: Process names that are never started by an agent.

busyBeforeTests.description: Process names or globs (for example *_test.exe) that must not be running when a test suite starts; the tester and the leader check the process list before every suite run (no hook enforces this). Without .exe.

testPorts.description: Fixed ports test suites bind; suites sharing one run in sequence.

environment.description: Persistent (user or machine scope) environment variable writes from a shell: setx, [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable(name, value, User|Machine), the HKCU/HKLM Environment registry keys. Process-scope writes ($env:X, set X=) are never checked.

persistentWrites.description: Decision for a persistent write of a variable not listed in protectedVars.

protectedVars.description: Variable names or globs (BINPICK_*, PATH) whose persistent writes are denied; case-insensitive. A write whose name the guard cannot read asks.

asciiExtensions.description: Files with these extensions must be pure ASCII, comments included (the guard-edit hook rejects non-ASCII writes).

asciiExempt.description: Path globs exempt from the ASCII rule (vendored code, translation files).

asciiRepoMarkdown.description: Also require ASCII in tracked README.md and docs/ markdown (the docs gate checks it). Markdown under .claude/ is always exempt.

codePage.description: The machine's ANSI code page when it is not UTF-8 (for example cp932); enables the PowerShell source-write guard.

isolation.description: How parallel agents isolate builds. slots: build-wt/slotN directories sharing one source tree. worktrees: git worktrees. none: implementers run in sequence.

buildDirPatterns.description: Directory globs that format and gate hooks skip.

toolchain.description: Free-form machine facts the packs read (vsRoot, vcvars, arch, qtDir, cmakeExe, clangFormatExe, jomExe, generator ...). Mirror them in project/build-env.md for humans.

formatOnEdit.description: if-config-present: run the formatter on an edited file only when the repo has a formatter config (.clang-format). never: keep the file's own style.

runtime.description: node is the kit standard. powershell selects the minimal hooks-powershell pack for machines without Node.

failMode.description: Safety guards fail open (allow + stderr note) on their own errors. The model guard always fails closed.

autoMode.description: Permission modes in which a hook 'ask' does not reach the human (observed 2026-10-18: git push ran in auto mode without a prompt). In those modes an ask of a listed category becomes a deny that tells the agent to ask the human in chat.

modes.description: Values of the hook input's permission_mode treated as unattended (default, plan, acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, dontAsk).

askToDeny.description: Ask categories that become a deny in those modes.

packs.description: Enabled packs, by folder name under packs/. install.js activates their rules, agents, skills, commands and hooks.

packConfig.description: Per-pack settings keyed by pack name (for example cpp-cmake-gtest.goldenDir, cpp-qmake-qt.umbrellaPro, controller-kernel.coreDirs, work-package.wpDir, docs-spec-driven.machinePathRoots). Each pack documents its keys in its README.
